'''Jaiyna Sibinth''' was a [[human]] [[xenolinguist]]. She regularly attended the [[Aki-Aki]] [[Festival of the Ancestors]] on [[Pasaana]], studying the Aki-Aki's ancient [[language]]. Sibinth noted recurring themes and symbols found in cultures native to other [[desert]] worlds, including [[Cona]], [[Klatooine]], [[Sriluur]], and [[Tatooine]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jaiyna Sibinth first appeared in the [[2019]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref> She was first identified in ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book for the film written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. Although Sibinth's first name is spelled Jaiyna in the main text, the book's index spelled her name as "Jaina."<ref name="TROS VD" /> When questioned on the proper spelling of the character's name, [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Matt Martin]] recommended to give precedence to the name used in the character's entry in the book over the index and noted the spelling distinguished Sibinth from the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] character [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].<ref name="Matt Martin spelling">{{Twitter|missingwords|1214264577728245760|[[Matt Martin]]|quote=I'd go with the actual entry rather than the index. It also gets away from Jaina Solo.|archivefile=File:MattMartin_JaiynaSibinth_tweet.png|archiveurl=https://archive.is/JW3jD}}</ref>

Sibinth was played by [[Raiyah bint Hussein]],<ref name="Raiya tweet">{{Twitter|Ned_Donovan|status/1208085932647354368|Ned Donovan|quote=Not content with being an academic on Planet Earth, my fiancée Raiyah has recently found time to also become one in the Star Wars universe. Keep your eyes peeled for Jaiyna Sibinth in the new film, partly shot in the absolutely stunning Wadi Rum desert in Jordan.|archivefile=File:JaiynaSibinth_RaiyahbintHussein_tweet.png|archivedate=20191225040302}}</ref> a [[Wikipedia:Princess Raiyah bint Hussein|Princess]] of the [[Wikipedia:Hashemites|royal family]] of [[Wikipedia:Jordan|Jordan]],<ref name="Princess">{{WebCite|url=http://petra.gov.jo/Include/InnerPage.jsp?ID=20031&lang=en&name=en_news|text=Statement from the Royal Hashemite Court|date=2019-11-05|language=English|quote=The Royal Hashemite Court is pleased to announce the engagement of Her Royal Highness Princess Raiyah bint Al Hussein to Mr Faris Ned Donovan.|archivedate=20191225042133}}</ref> where the Pasaana scenes were filmed in the country's [[Wikipedia:Wadi Rum|Wadi Rum]] desert.<ref name="Vanity Fair Preview">{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2019/05/star-wars-cover-story?verso=true|text=''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'', The Ultimate Preview|author=Grossman, Lev|date=2019-05-22|work=Vanity Fair|archivedate=20191223092407}}</ref> Like her character, Raiyah bint Hussein is an academic and is currently a [[Wikipedia:Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] candidate at the [[Wikipedia:University of California, Los Angeles|University of California, Los Angeles]] as of November 2019.<ref name="Princess" /> The character's name is based on the princess' name.
